gate_224.note: presence/absence, B43 §5's floor case, collapses into this: the unperturbed arm's Delta is exactly zero under the pairing, so presence is decodable at any amplitude that clears the floor

determinism.claim: B43 §3: the sandbox is deterministic, so the conditioned form I(P;Delta|C) reads log k by construction and is vacuous
